name: Jeanne Lefevre
source: A student tutor, Jeanne does her best to help students learn the ins and outs of mathematics and various sciences. She provides ample detail in her notes and in her lessons - far more than some people might be comfortable with. Insatiably curious about subjects that interest her, she often spends hours in the library or on her laptop learning everything she needs to know. She also runs the Astronomy Club with Isolda.
